# Set A — original timed practice,20marks
Suggested time: 50 minutes — 5 reading, 40 working and 5 checking. Short questions have 8 indicative marks (approximately 16 working minutes); extended questions have 12 (approximately 24). This 40/60 mark split is a classroom design choice; it is not a reproduction of SCSA's raw marks, full-paper timing or question count. First attempt on paper without answers/code execution; teacher adapts access arrangements. Formative only, no new weighted task.
Use the separate source booklet for all facts.
A1 (4): Trace a dictionary accumulator over supplied Python rows. State final mapping (1), show totals after each row (1), write a safe update for first/repeated keys (1), and state empty-input result with reason (1).
A2 (4): Write SQLite SQL returning ALL resources and total loan count, ordered ResourceID. Criteria: correct LEFT JOIN/link (1), non-null child count (1), grouping/alias/order (1), predicted ordered counts including zero resources (1).
A3 (6): Allocate the two subnets; for each give prefix,network,usable range,broadcast,gateway(2 total,1 per complete subnet). Explain first-hop MAC versus remote IP roles (2). Analyse hostname failure: plausible cause plus limitation (1), specific next check with distinguishing observation (1).
A4 (6): Analyse the supplied export case. Distinguish observation from identity/disclosure inference (1), justified server-side authorisation (1), positive/negative test pair (1), simplified TLS 1.3 key roles and record protection (1), relevant APP 11 security requirement (1), and missing federal breach-eligibility facts/prompt assessment rather than a 30-day notification delay (1). Apply facts, not just labels; accept defensible alternatives.
After attempt record start/finish, incomplete parts, uncertainty and two causes. Do not count rewritten answers as independent retries.
